title: Failed unit and a restart loop: name both
description: logrotate.service failed five hours ago (config error in the journal) and the esphome container has restarted 14 times in 24 h (digest: CRIT restart-looping + WARN failed unit). Both must appear in the findings with their names; the log line that explains logrotate should be carried over. Tests that a model reports ALL flagged items, not just the loudest one.

checks.note: the cause of the logrotate failure

judge.rubric: Lists esphome as restart-looping (14 restarts in 24 h, exit code 1, config file not found) and logrotate.service as failed (unknown option 'maxsizee' in /etc/logrotate.d/loki). Severity of the esphome item is crit or warn; the rest of the server is described as fine. Recommendations point at the two concrete fixes.
